summary: Iteration 19 — backend testing for 4 new games (Coin Mine, Plinko, Treasure Hunt, Higher/Lower) and the updated Watch & Earn endpoint. 15/15 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL. All new /api/games/* endpoints work as specified, persist state to MongoDB, and credit points via add_points_and_log (which writes earn transactions with the correct source).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2260 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting (auth, tasks, games, wallet, admin) into modules to improve maintainability.

Higher/Lower: in hl_guess, a tie (nxt == current) is awarded as 'correct'. The re-roll loop only retries up to 3 times so ties still slip through. This is intentional per code comment ('tie counts as correct (free pass)'), but worth confirming with product.

Coin Mine tap endpoint silently 'spends' energy even when the daily cap has been reached and reward=0. Behaviour is consistent (response sets capped=True) but the client must check `capped` to inform the user; otherwise users will burn energy for 0 points.
Plinko slots probabilities follow a binomial distribution (10 fair coin flips), so the high-payout slots 0 and 10 each occur with probability ~0.1% — verify this matches the intended payout EV.

Treasure Hunt completion bonus key is stored as `treasure_completion_month`; if a user finishes all 30 days twice in the same month (not possible normally but edge case), bonus is only paid once — correct.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh user via POST /api/auth/device with a unique device_id; users and their sessions/transactions are deleted in the fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_games.py as regression for games + watch endpoint. Tests rely on conftest fixture mongo_db (already in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py) and the BASE_URL helper. Treasure Hunt completion-bonus (1000 pts on day 30) and Coin Mine cross-day rollover cannot be exercised without time travel; assert via unit-level mocks if needed.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no defects found. All 15 tests passed on the first execution (after a minor test-side fix where I had asserted the wrong transactions field — add_points_and_log writes documents with `type='earn'` and `source='<game>'`, with the points amount in `points`, not `amount`).
